photos.background_source: AI-generated Shibuya Scramble Crossing at dusk (inspired by the location; not a Google Street View image)
photos.comment: 渋谷の夕方、スクランブル交差点の真ん中で一枚。ネオンと人の波に負けないくらい、今日のわたしも鮮やかだったよ。
photos.location: 渋谷スクランブル交差点

photos.background_source: AI-generated Kiyomizu-dera wooden stage in autumn (inspired by the location; not a Google Street View image)
photos.comment: 清水の舞台から見る紅葉、すごかった。木の舞台の上で、秋の京都をひとりじめした気分。

photos.background_source: AI-generated Kiyomizu-dera wooden stage in autumn (inspired by the location; not a Google Street View image)
photos.comment: 手すりに寄りかかって、紅葉と三重塔をゆっくり眺めたよ。急がなくていい時間って、旅のごほうびだね。

photos.background_source: AI-generated Kiyomizu-dera wooden stage in autumn, natural saturation (inspired by the location; not a Google Street View image)
photos.comment: 曇り空の日の清水寺。紅葉の色も、目で見たままの落ち着いた色で残しておきたかった。手すりの木の感触まで思い出せる一枚。

photos.background_source: AI-generated Kiyomizu-dera wooden stage in autumn, realistic photo-style background, anime face kept faithful to master (inspired by the location; not a Google Street View image)
photos.comment: 顔は元画像のまま、背景は目で見たままの京都。アニメのわたしが実写の紅葉の中にいる、そのちぐはぐさも含めてお気に入りの一枚。

photos.background_source: AI-generated Kiyomizu-dera wooden stage in autumn, realistic photo-style background with structurally faithful three-story pagoda, anime face kept faithful to master (inspired by the location; not a Google Street View image)
photos.comment: 三重塔は本物の三層・朱色のまま。黒いシースルーのアームカバーも普段着の仲間入り。ブーツまでちゃんと写った、記念写真らしい一枚。

photos.background_source: AI-generated Kiyomizu-dera wooden stage in autumn, realistic photo-style background with structurally faithful three-story pagoda, body drawn and colored in v3 style, anime face kept faithful to master (inspired by the location; not a Google Street View image)
photos.comment: 体の描き方はv3のやわらかい陰影のまま。紅葉が舞う中で、三重塔を眺める秋の午後。

photos.background_source: AI-generated Champ de Mars and Eiffel Tower in November, realistic photo-style background, structurally faithful tower (inspired by the location; not a Google Street View image)
photos.comment: 11月のパリ、曇り空のシャン・ド・マルス。落ち葉は地面の近くで、木の高さは越えないように。エッフェル塔の鉄のレースがきれいだった。

photos.background_source: AI-generated Westminster Bridge, Big Ben and Palace of Westminster in November, realistic photo-style background, structurally faithful tower and palace (inspired by the location; not a Google Street View image)
photos.comment: ロンドンの曇り空、ビッグ・ベンの時計が11時ごろを指してた。落ち葉は橋の上に静かに置いてあるだけ。雨上がりの石畳が光ってた。

photos.background_source: AI-generated Sydney Opera House and harbour in late spring, realistic photo-style background, structurally faithful Opera House (inspired by the location; not a Google Street View image)
photos.comment: 南半球は春の終わり、23℃の晴れ。暖かいからアームカバーなしの半袖スタイル。白い貝殻の屋根と青い港がまぶしかった。
photos.location: シドニー・オペラハウス

photos.background_source: AI-generated Sydney Opera House and harbour in late spring, realistic photo-style background, structurally faithful Opera House (inspired by the location; not a Google Street View image)
photos.comment: オペラハウスの前で記念撮影、ピース！暖かい日だから半袖スタイルのまま。港の青と白い貝殻の屋根、最高の組み合わせ。
photos.location: シドニー・オペラハウス

photos.background_source: AI-generated Nakamise shopping street and Senso-ji five-story pagoda in Asakusa in late November, realistic photo-style background, structurally faithful pagoda and main hall (inspired by the location; not a Google Street View image)
photos.comment: 仲見世の赤い提灯と五重塔の前で一枚。晩秋の浅草、人形焼の甘い香りとにぎわいに包まれて、なんだか懐かしい気持ちになったよ。

photos.background_source: AI-generated Nakamise shopping street and Senso-ji five-story pagoda in Asakusa in late November, MUSE walking with a bag of ningyo-yaki, face pasted from the master image (inspired by the location; not a Google Street View image)
photos.comment: 仲見世を歩いて人形焼を買ったよ。顔は元画像をそのまま貼り付け。中央に立たず、五重塔を背に歩く姿を切り取った一枚。

photos.background_source: AI-generated Momijidani Park on Miyajima at dusk during the maple light-up, red Momiji Bridge over a stream, lanterns and illuminated maple trees, MUSE pausing on the bridge, face pasted from the master image (inspired by the location; not a Google Street View image)
photos.comment: 紅葉谷公園のライトアップ、真っ赤なもみじと提灯のあかりがきれいだったよ。赤い紅葉橋の上でひと休み、夕方の宮島は静かで特別な時間だった。

photos.background_source: AI-generated Momijidani Park on Miyajima at night during the maple light-up, red Momiji Bridge over a stream, lanterns and illuminated maple trees, MUSE by the stream looking up at the maple leaves, face generated (no paste) in anime style (inspired by the location; not a Google Street View image)
photos.comment: 川辺に立って、ライトアップされた真っ赤なもみじを見上げたよ。提灯のあかりと紅葉に包まれて、夜の紅葉谷公園は昼とは違う顔を見せてくれた。

photos.background_source: AI-generated Korankei valley in late November, red Taigetsu-kyo bridge over the Tomoe River, red maple trees at peak colour, MUSE walking along the riverside path looking up at the maples, face generated (no paste) in anime style (inspired by the location; not a Google Street View image)
photos.comment: 巴川沿いの道を歩いて、真っ赤なもみじを見上げたよ。赤い待月橋と紅葉のトンネル、11月下旬の香嵐渓はまさに見頃だった。

photos.background_source: AI-generated Kenrokuen Garden at night during the autumn maple light-up, Kotoji stone lantern and snow-rope-wrapped Karasaki pine by Kasumiga-ike pond, lantern light reflecting on the water, MUSE pausing on the bridge looking up at the illuminated red maples, face generated (no paste) in anime style (inspired by the location; not a Google Street View image)
photos.comment: 霞ヶ池の橋の欄干にもたれて、ライトアップされた真っ赤なもみじを見上げたよ。徽軫灯籠と雪吊りの松、池に映る灯り——11月22日の今夜だけの兼六園だった。

photos.background_source: AI-generated Meiji Jingu Gaien ginkgo avenue in late November, golden tunnel of 146 ginkgo trees with the Meiji Memorial Picture Gallery at the far end, morning light and a carpet of fallen golden leaves, MUSE walking along the avenue holding a ginkgo leaf and looking up at the canopy, face generated (no paste) in anime style (inspired by the location; not a Google Street View image)
photos.comment: 金色のトンネルを歩いて、ひらりと落ちてきたイチョウの葉を一枚。並木の向こうに聖徳記念絵画館、足元は黄金のじゅうたん——11月23日の朝の外苑だった。
photos.location: 明治神宮外苑いちょう並木

photos.background_source: AI-generated Lake Kawaguchi Momiji Corridor at night during the maple festival light-up, red maple tunnel over a stream, paper lanterns, Mt. Fuji silhouette in the dusk sky, MUSE walking on the wooden walkway looking up at the illuminated maples, face generated (no paste) in anime style (inspired by the location; not a Google Street View image)
